title: Grand Theft Auto VI pre-download begins November 10
summary: Tips to prepare for November 19 launch day, including pre-downloads and storage tips.

Tim Turi (he/him) Content Communications Manager, Sony Interactive Entertainment Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19 on PlayStation 5, with pre-download available starting November 10. Whether you’re returning to the series or jumping in for the first time, here are a few key steps you can take now to prepare for launch day. Step 1: Set up your PlayStation account Make sure your PlayStation account is ready to go before launch. If you’re new to PlayStation, create an account and sign in on your console. Existing players should confirm their sign-in information and account details are up to date. How to set up your PlayStation account Step 2: Pre-order Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-order Grand Theft Auto VI through PlayStation Store or participating retailers to ensure you’re ready to play as soon as the game becomes available on November 19. Pre-order the Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition to receive an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story. Visit the PlayStation Store product page for available editions, pricing, and additional details. Pre-order Grand Theft Auto VI Step 3: Get ready to pre-download Pre-download timing will be available to those who pre-order starting at November 10 local midnight. Get ready by clearing a minimum of 212GB of storage space on your PS5. You can also explore options to extend your PS5 storage ahead of GTAVI . Downloading the game before release means you’ll be ready to jump in as soon as it becomes available. Stay tuned for additional details later this year. Step 4: Complete your PS5 setup Players looking to personalize their experience can explore accessories including the DualSense Edge wireless controller , PlayStation Pulse wireless headset , Pulse Elevate Wireless speakers and other PlayStation 5 products. Learn more about the available PlayStation accessories and find the setup that works best for you. Explore PS5 accessories Stay tuned for more We’ll have more information on Grand Theft Auto VI as we get closer to November 19. Grand Theft Auto VI Did you like this?
